reason: I only need full-site screenshots a few times a year, around a launch or a redesign handoff, so a monthly subscription for daily re-captures is paying for something I'd barely use. The free 15-page tier probably covers my occasional needs, and with zero reviews I'm not putting money down on a brand-new tool anyway.
objection: I don't need ongoing monitoring, I need a clean full-page capture on a phone now and then, and there's nothing yet showing it actually works on real client sites with sliders, lazy-loaded images and sticky headers.
would_change_my_mind: A pay-per-use option, like a few dollars for one full-site capture on desktop and phone, plus some real reviews or sample captures from live sites showing the mobile screenshots come out right.
